column3: an answer key: a sheet of cream paper with a column of green check marks, and a large golden old-fashioned key lying diagonally across the sheet

a messy office desk seen from the front at a slight high angle: wooden top buried under scattered papers at odd angles, many yellow, pink and teal sticky notes stuck everywhere (with illegible squiggles, NOT letters), an overturned coffee mug, a tangled cable, crumpled paper balls, an open laptop with a blank screen; busy but friendly; no person, no chair

a friendly round-headed little judge robot in a dark judge's robe with a white collar, wearing a teal blindfold over its eyes, holding a big magnifying glass in one hand; standing, full body, cheerful; no gavel, no text

a neat stack of about eight square yellow sticky notes seen from the front at a slight angle, the top one slightly lifted with a few illegible grey pen squiggles (NOT letters), a red pen lying beside the stack
a manila file folder, slightly open, with a few cream papers sticking out of the top, a teal (#2dd4bf) index tab with nothing written on it
